claude.sample_unit: consent form documents (64 original, 64 AI-generated, 64 AI-simplified)

links.outcome: Reading age of surgical consent forms versus nationally recommended reading age (≤11 years)
links.effect: Original GIRFT forms mean RA 16.39 ± 0.85 years; AI-generated 17.65 ± 0.73; AI-simplified 13.27 ± 0.67. No form achieved RA ≤ 11 years.
links.quote: No form achieved a RA ≤ 11 years.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated and AI-simplified patient consent materials in plain language
links.effect: AI-generated forms were harder to read (17.65 ± 0.73 years, p < 0.001); AI-simplified easier (13.27 ± 0.67 years) but still above recommended reading age. FRE ≥ 50: 100% simplified, 45.3% originals, 15.6% AI-generated.
links.quote: AI-generated forms were harder to read (17.65 ± 0.73 years, p < 0.001), whereas AI-simplified forms were easier (13.27 ± 0.67 years, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Readability of consent documents relative to plain-language targets
links.effect: Original consent forms mean reading age 16.39 ± 0.85 years; none of 192 documents achieved reading age ≤ 11 years.
links.quote: Consent forms often exceed the reading ability of populations they serve.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM simplification of existing clinically validated consent forms rather than de novo generation
